items.caption:
A faixa de j-hope em colaboração com as LE SSERAFIM, 'SPAGHETTI (feat. j-hope of BTS)', venceu nas categorias Best Collaboration e Best Song Top 10.

Os BTS conquistaram cinco troféus nos 2026 MAMA AWARDS, incluindo o de Artista do Ano e o de Álbum do Ano. O grupo venceu ainda nas categorias Best Song Top 10, Best Male Group e Fans' Choice.
Esta vitória elevou para 24 o total de Daesang (Grande Prémio) dos BTS na MAMA. Os BTS não puderam estar presentes na cerimónia devido ao calendário da sua digressão mundial e enviaram uma mensagem em vídeo.

items.audio_start: 0:27 Run away out of sight, don't know what I want (추정)
items.caption:
Their Artist of the Year win marked their 8th trophy in that category.

BTS could not attend the ceremony due to their world tour schedule and sent a video message instead. j-hope's featured track with LE SSERAFIM, 'SPAGHETTI (feat. j-hope of BTS)', won Best Collaboration and Best Song Top 10. BTS won five trophies at the 2026 MAMA AWARDS, including Artist of the Year and Album of the Year.

The group also took Best Song Top 10, Best Male Group, and Fans' Choice. The win brought BTS's total Daesang (Grand Prize) count at MAMA to 24.

08 🇺🇸 BTS — 방탄소년단, ‘26 MAMA’ 대상 2개 포함 5관.caption:
Their Artist of the Year win marked their 8th trophy in that category.

BTS could not attend the ceremony due to their world tour schedule and sent a video message instead. j-hope's featured track with LE SSERAFIM, 'SPAGHETTI (feat. j-hope of BTS)', won Best Collaboration and Best Song Top 10. BTS won five trophies at the 2026 MAMA AWARDS, including Artist of the Year and Album of the Year.

The group also took Best Song Top 10, Best Male Group, and Fans' Choice. The win brought BTS's total Daesang (Grand Prize) count at MAMA to 24.
